scope.model_call_definition: One LocalTunnel/Codex CLI invocation per ledger row. Internal CLI reconnect/retry events are not separate experiment calls; they may represent multiple backend requests and are not independently counted here.
scope.private_content_policy: No raw article text, model prompt bodies, credentials, or article excerpts are included.

token_accounting_rules: Sum input_tokens + output_tokens from every available CLI turn.completed usage record, including rejected turns with known usage.
Cached input and reasoning output are recorded separately but are not added again to input + output totals.
The three timed-out attempts have usage unknown, not zero. The known subtotal is incomplete; no complete run token total is claimed.
Usage records are provider-reported counters, not an independent billing reconciliation.

runtime_failure_interpretation.calls_6_to_8: a702-harness search_plan, direct_response and synthesis hit the 180-second host timeout. Their diagnostic streams are absent because TimeoutExpired raises before _save_diagnostics. No per-call DNS/auth/quota cause or token count can be recovered from these missing streams.
runtime_failure_interpretation.call_9: a702-harness decompose has explicit DNS/address-resolution failures for chatgpt.com and network retries. The CLI later emitted a response and turn.completed usage, with exit code zero. The adapter rejected the stream because earlier error events existed. Its 16,902 input + 909 output tokens are included despite failure.
runtime_failure_interpretation.clock_limit: Journal UTC elapsed durations substantially exceed monotonic wall_seconds on failed calls. This audit records both; it does not independently attribute the discrepancy to machine sleep without a separate OS-log audit.
runtime_failure_interpretation.cause_limit: No authentication or quota failure markers were found in retained call-9 diagnostics. Their absence does not prove that every unobserved timeout had the same cause.

chronology_authority_caveat.outer_journal: Outer model-io.json packets and responses may contain later host mutations, including future prior_decisions and appended tool results. Do not treat them as immutable chronological inputs or unmodified model outputs.
chronology_authority_caveat.output_authority: Use original CLI event outputs and pre-normalization workflow snapshots. Call-9 response emission does not override its frozen rejected status.
chronology_authority_caveat.input_authority: Completed harness item-level workflow snapshots preserve post-advice logical inputs. Inner native snapshots precede advice additions. Exact serialized CLI stdin was not independently retained in inspected artifacts. Retrieval-input reconstruction is conditional and must state uncertainty.
chronology_authority_caveat.status_limit: All shared final forecasts completed, but this does not convert failed native/research stages into successful source traces or demonstrate risk/fraud accuracy.
